strategies.name: Aurora Health Background
strategies.description: A soft, slow-moving mesh gradient background that changes color based on overall health status (e.g., green/blue for good, soft orange for warnings).
strategies.purpose: Creates a calming, ambient feeling rather than a clinical one.

strategies.name: Pulse Animation
strategies.description: Heart rate icon or indicator pulses according to the actual simulated heart rate data.
strategies.purpose: Provides immediate, intuitive feedback of the vital sign.

strategies.name: Glassmorphism Cards
strategies.description: Data cards have a slight backdrop-filter blur and a semi-transparent white background, allowing the aurora background to peek through.
strategies.purpose: Enhances the 'clean, airy' aesthetic while maintaining high readability.

strategies.name: Layout Flip on Elderly Mode
strategies.description: Smooth transition when switching to elderly mode. Elements resize, reorder, and change appearance seamlessly without a hard refresh.
strategies.purpose: Prevents jarring context loss for elderly users during state changes.

generative_ui_integration: Use a subtle, ambient Canvas/WebGL layer for the background to represent the 'flow' of health, ensuring it does not distract from the data readability.
